summary: Cas wakes in a studio apartment, likely Arthur's or Rio's, after an escape in which Rio took out Pithica's troops and held Dawna Polk hostage to trade for their release. Arthur tends to Cas, who is hooked to an IV, and grumbles about Rio, whom Cas refuses to call a friend. Rio then returns from outside, where it has been raining, and Cas says she is getting better.
one_line: Cas wakes injured in an apartment after Rio's escape from Pithica's troops, with Arthur tending to her and Rio returning.
key_facts: Cas wakes in a spacious studio apartment that she does not recognize, which she assumes belongs to Arthur or Rio.
An IV stand stands beside Cas's bed, with a catheter taped into the back of her hand.
Arthur was sleeping on a pillow and blanket on the floor close enough to keep an eye on Cas, probably.
Rio took out the troops and took Dawna Polk hostage to get them out.
Arthur says the group managed to trade Dawna Polk to get out, because she is so valuable that only a handful of people can do the mental jazz.
Arthur believes Dawna Polk is one of Pithica's higher-ups.
Cas refuses to tell Arthur how Rio and she met.
Rio returns to the apartment in his customary tan duster, with water slicking the mantle in dark patches.
Cas notes that the rainy season in Los Angeles usually starts in December or January, though sometimes months earlier.
Cas tells Rio that she feels like she has been shot.
Cas says she is feeling better and is awake, and she is more energetic.
